transitions.label: POST /{id}/deactivate
transitions.note: Refused 422 CURRENCY_HOLDS_BALANCE if any account in this currency still holds a balance or held amount

cards.title: Two writers only
items: Activate() and Deactivate() are the only methods that change IsActive
Both are [CrudAction] routes on the same generated composite

cards.title: Deactivation is not deletion
items: Existing accounts and postings in this currency are unaffected
Only opening a NEW account in this currency is refused (UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY)
